HEADLINE: This is to inform you that the Board of Directors of the Company at its meeting held today i.e. 22nd October 2026 inter-alia considered and approved the Unaudited Financial Results for ....
MORE:
This is to inform you that the Board of Directors of the Company at its meeting held today i.e. 22nd October 2026 inter-alia considered and approved the Unaudited Financial Results for the second quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026.

Pursuant to Regulation 33 of the SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, the Unaudited Financial Results for the second quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026 along with Limited Review Report of the Statutory Auditor's thereon are enclosed herewith for your information and record.

Further, in accordance with Regulation 47(1) of the LODR Regulations, the Company would be publishing extract of the Unaudited Financial Results for the second quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026 along with a Quick Response (QR) code and the details of the webpage where complete Financial Results will be available.
NEWSSUB: Unaudited Financial Results For The Second Quarter And Half Year Ended 30Th September, 2026
